title: AccessReviewTask
description: An AccessReviewTask is a SOURCING-LAYER EXTENSION and a HUMAN HANDOFF object. It is raised by the Source Discovery Scout or a connector when a promising source is found but cannot be fully accessed, collected, or legally evaluated without human help (login, registration, paid subscription, manual download, credentials, terms/legal review, etc.). It is NOT Evidence, a Claim, a Signal, a BankNeed, or an Opportunity, and must never carry downstream intelligence content. It links back to the SourceCandidate that raised it via candidate_id (the SourceCandidate references it via access_review_task_id). task_status is the AUTHORITATIVE ROLLUP state, computed deterministically from human_review.review_status and resolution.resolution_status; it must not be hand-edited into a state inconsistent with those sub-statuses (JSON Schema cannot fully enforce this cross-field rule). resolution.resolution_status = source_promoted mirrors the SourceCandidate.promotion / Source Registry update; it does not replace them as the source of truth.

task_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this access-review task.

discovery_run_id.description: Identifier of the discovery run that raised this task; links to data/run_logs.

candidate_id.description: candidate_id of the SourceCandidate that raised this task (SourceCandidate.access_review_task_id points back here).

created_at.description: When the task was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

updated_at.description: When the task was last updated (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

task_status.description: AUTHORITATIVE ROLLUP state for the task, computed deterministically from human_review.review_status and resolution.resolution_status. It must not be hand-edited independently of those sub-statuses.

priority.description: Triage priority for the human handoff.

sector.description: Which side of Printec's market the source primarily serves.

workstream.description: Workstream code per architecture section 16 (A7 is intentionally not defined).

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source this task concerns.

source_url.description: Primary/landing URL of the source. May be only the landing page; see target_urls for specific assets.

target_urls.description: Specific report, PDF, download page, document page, tender page, or asset URLs the human should inspect. May be empty when no specific asset is known.

access_status.description: Access boundary per sourcing_layer_scope.md section 7. Matches SourceCandidate.access_status.

legal_status.description: Legal disposition for collecting from this source. Matches SourceCandidate.legal_status.

blocker_type.description: Technical/policy diagnosis of the blocker. Definitions: login_required = an interactive login form blocks access; free_registration_required = a free account signup appears necessary; paid_subscription_required = paid access is necessary; credentials_needed = credentials may exist or may be granted but are not currently available to the system; manual_download_required = a human likely has to download a file manually; file_not_directly_linked = the landing page references a file/report but the downloadable asset is not directly reachable; forbidden_source = the source appears legally or policy-forbidden for collection.

observed_blocker.description: Free-text description of what actually blocked access, as observed.

automated_attempts.description: History of automated access attempts. May be empty if the task was raised from classification alone rather than an actual fetch attempt.

attempted_at.description: When this attempt was made (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

attempted_by.description: Routine or connector that made the attempt.

actions.description: Actions taken during the attempt. May be empty.

result_summary.description: Short summary of the attempt result.

error_messages.description: Error messages captured during the attempt. May be empty.

artifact_paths.description: Paths to artifacts captured during the attempt; screenshots are allowed as artifacts. May be empty.

requested_human_actions.description: Non-empty, de-duplicated list of concrete actions requested from the human.

requested_actions_notes.description: Nullable free-text that should explain any 'other' action or otherwise clarify the request.

human_review.description: Human review state for access/legal/credential clearance. Feeds the task_status rollup. Null-valued fields are expected before review occurs.

review_status.description: This enum is intentionally different from SourceCandidate.review.review_status: AccessReviewTask tracks human access/legal/credential review, not candidate lifecycle review.

reviewer.description: Identifier of the human reviewer; null until reviewed.

reviewed_at.description: When reviewed (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null until reviewed.

review_notes.description: Free-text reviewer notes; null if none.

legal_notes.description: Notes on legal/terms considerations; null if none.

credentials_notes.description: Notes on credentials/access provisioning; null if none.

redistribution_notes.description: Notes on redistribution/retention constraints; null if none.

resolution.description: Resolution state of the task. Feeds the task_status rollup. Null-valued fields are expected before resolution.

resolution_status.description: Outcome of the task. 'source_promoted' mirrors SourceCandidate.promotion / the Source Registry update; it does not replace them as the source of truth.

resolved_at.description: When resolved (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null until resolved.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved the task; null until resolved.

outcome_summary.description: Free-text summary of the resolution outcome; null if not yet resolved.

linked_uploaded_document_ids.description: IDs of documents manually uploaded as a result of this task (pointers only; not document content). May be empty.

updated_candidate_id.description: candidate_id updated as a result; null if none.

updated_source_id.description: Source Registry source_id updated as a result; null if none.

follow_up_required.description: Whether further follow-up is required after this resolution.

follow_up_notes.description: Notes on required follow-up; null if none.

assigned_to.description: Optional. Person or queue the task is assigned to; null if unassigned.

due_at.description: Optional. When the task should be resolved by (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); important for time-sensitive sources such as tenders. Null if none.

time_sensitive.description: Optional. True when the source/asset is time-sensitive (e.g. a tender with a closing date).

raised_by.description: Optional. The routine or connector that raised this task.

cost_hint.description: Optional. Rough cost indication for paid access; null if unknown.

cost_notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes on cost; null if none.

metadata.description: Optional free-form extension bag. This is the ONLY place additional properties are allowed.
